settings.label: Customization fee product
settings.info: Hidden Rs. 10 product used to charge making/certification fees at checkout. Added to the cart automatically at the right quantity and kept in sync with the customized item. Until this is set, fees are display-only and NOT charged.

settings.content: The store sells in INR only — checkout, orders and payouts stay in rupees. Visitors detected outside India see every price converted to US$ for reference, with a note that they are billed in INR; an INR/USD toggle in the header lets anyone switch.

settings.label: Show prices in US$ to visitors outside India
Use a live exchange rate
settings.info: Fetched in the visitor's browser at most every 12 hours from Frankfurter (European Central Bank data), with ExchangeRate-API as backup. Turn off to always use the fixed rate below.

settings.label: Fixed rate: rupees per US$1
settings.info: Used when the live rate is off or cannot be fetched.

settings.label: Round US$ prices up by
settings.info: Optional cushion so the US$ figure is not below what a visitor's bank charges after its conversion fee.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.info: Fallback for pages without their own description. The homepage description is set in Shopify admin under Settings > Preferences and takes priority when present.

settings.label: UET tag ID
settings.info: Numeric ID from Microsoft Advertising > Tools > UET tag. Leave blank if UET is already installed as a Shopify custom pixel, otherwise page views double-count. Enhanced conversions (hashed email/phone) are attached automatically when set.

settings.content: Used for the Organization structured data (homepage, About page, gem guides), the About page and WhatsApp links on the gem guide pages.

settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Emitted as the Organization name. The Shopify store name is emitted as alternateName when it differs.

settings.label: Homepage title tag
settings.default: Precious Carats — Certified natural gemstones, every treatment disclosed
settings.info: Used instead of the Online Store → Preferences homepage title. Start it with the brand name so Google reads "Precious Carats" as the site name.

settings.label: One-line description
settings.default: Natural, certified gemstones for Vedic astrology, jewellery and collecting — every treatment disclosed, every certificate verifiable, honest unfiltered photos, 10-day returns on loose gemstones.

settings.label: Founding year
settings.info: Taken from the CIN (…DL2025…). Change it if the brand predates the company.

settings.label: Phone (displayed)
settings.info: The number wired into the theme's WhatsApp buttons. The contact page shows +91 99801 98011 — confirm which is right and fix the other.

settings.label: WhatsApp number (digits only, with country code)
Contact email
settings.info: Leave blank to use the store's sender email.

settings.content: AI chat that answers from the live catalogue, the policy pages, the gem guides and the Journal. It needs the Cloudflare Worker in workers/gem-bot deployed first (see its README). With a Worker URL filled in and the switch below off, only visitors who open the site with ?pc_chat=1 in the address see the chat — use that to test before going live.

settings.label: Show the chat assistant to all visitors
Worker URL
settings.info: For example https://pc-gem-bot.your-subdomain.workers.dev

settings.label: Greeting
settings.default: Namaste. I can help you find a gemstone, explain certification, shipping and returns, or check on an order. What are you looking for?
